claims.text: A bio (incl mirikizumab, risankizumab, guselkumab) ± immunomodulator can be first-line induction + maintenance, even b4 glucocorticoids.
claims.quote: A biologic agent (infliximab, adalimumab, certolizumab pegol, vedolizumab, ustekinumab, mirikizumab, risankizumab, guselkumab), with or without an immunomodulator (azathioprine, 6-mercaptopurine, or methotrexate) can be used as first-line therapy for induction and maintenance, even before a course of glucocorticoids.

claims.text: Skyrizi (risankizumab): mod-severe active Crohn dz in adults.
claims.quote: SKYRIZI is indicated for the treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn's disease in adults.
